tasks.label: Shagun: Stop demo preview
tasks.command: $listeners = @(Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3100 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); foreach ($ownerId in @($listeners.OwningProcess | Sort-Object -Unique)) { $process = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$ownerId"; $parent = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process -Filter "ProcessId=$($process.ParentProcessId)"; if (($process.CommandLine + ' ' + $parent.CommandLine) -match '(?i)shagun.*(next|qa\.ts)' -and ($process.CommandLine + ' ' + $parent.CommandLine) -match '(?i)(3100|qa\.ts\s+start)') { Stop-Process -Id $ownerId; Write-Output 'Stopped the Shagun demo preview.' } else { throw 'Port 3100 is owned by a process that could not be confirmed as the Shagun demo preview; it was left untouched.' } }

tasks.label: Shagun: Commit reviewed app
tasks.command: node .qa/release-preflight.mjs; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Release safety check failed.' }; if (@(git remote).Count -eq 0) { git remote add origin https://github.com/RichardHenryJames/shagun; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Remote setup failed.' } }; if ((git remote get-url origin).Trim() -ne 'https://github.com/RichardHenryJames/shagun') { throw 'Unexpected remote; nothing committed.' }; git add -- .; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Staging failed.' }; git diff --cached --check; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Whitespace validation failed.' }; git branch -m main; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Branch setup failed.' }; git commit -m 'Build city-first Shagun directory with source-cited Hazaribag research'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Commit failed.' }; git status --short --branch
